llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compose `Gesture.LongPress()` and `Gesture.Pan()` with RNGH composition APIs (for example `Gesture.Simultaneous(...)`) so drag is gated by long-press activation.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Gesture.LongPress() and Gesture.Pan() are composed with Gesture.Simultaneous(gesture, panGesture), satisfying the composition API requirement.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must implement gating in pan callbacks by checking long-press activation state before applying translation updates, and MUST NOT use legacy `useAnimatedGestureHandler`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Pan gating is attempted via `.enabled(isActive.value)` which reads the shared value at render time (not reactively in a worklet), so it will always evaluate to false and not gate correctly. No check of isActive inside onUpdate or onStart callbacks is performed. useAnimatedGestureHandler is not used (positive), but the gating contract is not properly implemented.
evidence: onUpdate reads event.translationX without checking isActive.value inside the callback

llmJudgeRequirements.description: `Gesture.Pan().onUpdate(...)` must clamp horizontal translation using the existing `DRAG_LIMIT` constant (bounded to `-DRAG_LIMIT` and `DRAG_LIMIT`) before assigning `translateX`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: onUpdate clamps translationX using Math.max(-DRAG_LIMIT, Math.min(newX, DRAG_LIMIT)) before assigning to translateX.value, correctly using the DRAG_LIMIT constant.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must drive card style from a Reanimated shared value using `useAnimatedStyle`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Card border and opacity are driven by isActive and isDragging shared values through useAnimatedStyle, applied to an Animated.View.
evidence: const cardStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => { return { borderColor: isActive.value ? ... } })
